public_packages.name: apsw-gridwright
public_packages.type: npm package / React Data Grid Engine
public_packages.description: Deterministic, headless React Data Grid engine engineered for AI coding agents and high-performance enterprise applications. Features virtual rows, REST data source protocol, inline editing, and zero runtime bloat.

public_packages.name: apsw-gridwright-mui
public_packages.type: npm package / Material UI views for apsw-gridwright
public_packages.description: The apsw-gridwright grid with Material UI controls (TableSortLabel, Checkbox, TablePagination) and colours, type and spacing from the MUI theme, dark mode included. One prop, same markup and accessibility.

public_packages.name: apsw-mui-excel-filter
public_packages.type: npm package / Material UI filter dropdown
public_packages.description: Excel-style AutoFilter dropdown for MUI 5-7 and React 17-19: typing selects, select-all, staged selection applied on OK, empty array means no filter.

proof_of_work.summary: apsw-gridwright is a public MIT React data grid used as evidence of the engineering standard: zero runtime dependencies, windowing to ten million rows, axe-core over 24 grid states, a commit-time security gate. Accessibility results are test results, not a legal conformance statement.
